frontend_ui_state_alignment_audit.issue_detected: While backend/app/api/papers.py updates SearchExperiment status through all 10 authoritative states, some frontend search handlers (e.g. in HybridSearchPage.tsx or LocalProgressPanel.tsx) check results.length === 0 before polling reaches terminal=true. This can briefly trigger a false '0 results' banner while retrieval status is still MERGING or RERANKING.

execution_state_audit.required_ui_guard: Frontend must check terminal === true AND (status === 'COMPLETED_NO_RESULTS' || status === 'FAILED') before rendering empty result UI.
